scope: Designed test cases only. No login implementation was supplied; execution is not claimed.
assumptions: Each case starts with the preconditions shown. Reset accounts between independent cases; only the sequence inside TC_13 carries state forward.

Input-validation failures (empty username or password, or password shorter than 6 characters) do not increment the authentication-failure counter. The requirements do not specify this behavior; it is a stated test assumption.

A successful login resets the consecutive authentication-failure counter. Account lockout is per registered account and continues until an authorized unlock; duration and unlock mechanism are outside the specified scope.
Quoted messages are proposed precise acceptance messages because the assignment gives no exact UI wording. Equivalent application wording may be accepted if it conveys the same result and state.
Both registered accounts exist before testing; stored credentials match the fixture values. Click Login for each submission. Fixture passwords are synthetic examples, not real account credentials.

cases.input: Unlocked; failures=0. Username=user1; Password=pass123. Click Login.
cases.expected: Login successful. Authenticated session created; consecutive failure count=0.
Display "Username is required." No login or authenticated session; count remains 0.
Display "Password is required." No login; count remains 0.

cases.input: Failures=0. Username=user1; Password=abc (3 characters). Click Login.
cases.expected: Display "Password must be at least 6 characters." No login; count remains 0.

cases.input: Failures=0. Username=user1; Password=abc12 (5 characters). Click Login.
cases.expected: Display "Password must be at least 6 characters." No login; count remains 0.

cases.input: Unlocked; failures=0. Username=user6; Password=abc123 (registered password, 6 characters). Click Login.
cases.expected: Login successful. Exactly 6 characters satisfies the length rule; authenticated session created.

cases.input: user1 unlocked; failures=0. Username=user1; Password=wrong77. Click Login.
cases.expected: Display "Invalid username or password." No session; user1 failure count becomes 1; account stays unlocked.
Display "Invalid username or password." No session. No registered account is locked by this request.

cases.input: user1 unlocked; failures=0. Username=user1; Password=abc123 (6 characters, not user1 password). Click Login.
cases.expected: Length validation passes; display "Invalid username or password." No session; failure count becomes 1.

cases.input: user1 unlocked; failures=1. Username=user1; Password=wrong77. Click Login.
cases.expected: Display "Invalid username or password." No session; failure count becomes 2; account remains unlocked.

cases.input: user1 unlocked; failures=2. Username=user1; Password=wrong77. Click Login.
cases.expected: Display "Account locked after 3 consecutive failed login attempts." No session; count reaches 3 and user1 is locked.

cases.input: user1 is already locked after 3 failures. Username=user1; Password=pass123. Click Login.
cases.expected: Display "Account is locked." Login is denied even though credentials are correct; account remains locked.

cases.scenario: Successful login breaks a failure sequence
cases.input: user1 unlocked; failures=2. Log in with user1/pass123, log out, then submit user1/wrong77.
cases.expected: First login succeeds and resets the consecutive count to 0. The later wrong password shows "Invalid username or password." Count=1; account remains unlocked.

cases.scenario: Lockout is specific to the account
cases.input: user1 locked; user6 unlocked with failures=0. Username=user6; Password=abc123. Click Login.
cases.expected: user6 logs in successfully. user1 remains locked; user6 is unaffected by another account lockout.
